assumptions_and_limits: Prices retrieved after the run on the same calendar date; not a launch-time price freeze.
Standard and Fast/priority are alternative pricing scenarios, not established account charges.
Input minus cached input is treated as ordinary uncached input; reported cache writes are zero.
Reasoning is already included in output; cached input is already included in input.
Parent/child inclusion semantics remain unverified; all cross-session sums are unreconciled arithmetic sums.
Raw summed dollars apply only if session counters are disjoint; no deduplicated experiment bill is asserted.
The historical coordinator snapshot omits its final tail and all later discussion.
Excludes tool fees, third-party services, regional or FedRAMP uplifts, and taxes.
Subscription charges cannot be inferred from API-equivalent token pricing.
Original experiment records and final hash inventory are unchanged.
